title: CPSC, Chuck E. Cheese's Announce Recall of Plastic Siren Whistles
summary: The recalled plastic siren whistle's internal pieces can detach from the toy, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 144,000.

title: CPSC, J & F Design Inc. Announce Recall of Girl's Sleepwear Sold at J.C. Penney Stores
summary: These pajamas sets fail to meet the federal mandatory standard for flammability of children's sleepwear under the Flammable Fabrics Act. This poses a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 18,800 sets.

title: CPSC, Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: Tie rod separation caused by either wear or severe impact can occur during operation, causing the front wheel to separate from the steering control. Separation of the tie rod can cause the rider to lose control of the ATV, resulting in a serious injury or death to the rider. Units: About 21,900.

title: CPSC, Toshiba America Consumer Products LLC Announce Recall of DVD Home Theater Systems
summary: A problem in the system's circuit board could pose a fire hazard. Units: About 4,100.

title: CPSC, Ideal Distributors Inc. Announce Recall of Pacifiers
summary: The nipples can detach from the base, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, King of Fans Inc. Announce Recall of Oil-Filled Radiator Heaters
summary: Welds in the heating fins can break, allowing oil to leak. This poses a burn and fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 202,000.

title: CPSC, Petters Consumer Brands LLC Announce Recall of Batteries Found In Polaroid Portable DVD Players
summary: The battery can overheat and melt the plastic case while recharging, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 165,000.

title: CPSC, Recreational Equipment Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Bicycles
summary: The alloy frame used for these bicycles can be prone to fatigue failure. Frame failure results in the separation of the fork, head tube, and handlebar away from the rest of the bike, causing a loss of control and crash, and posing a risk of serious injury to the rider. Units: About 2,800.

title: CPSC, Simplicity Inc. Announce Recall of Graco Branded Aspen Cribs for Suffocation Risk
summary: The screws on the wooden mattress support can come loose, allowing a portion of the mattress to fall, posing a suffocation hazard to young children. Units: About 104,000.

title: CPSC, CFM Corporation Announce Recall of Legacy Propane Infrared Plaque Heaters
summary: Carbon monoxide hazard. A non-specification gasket around the heating plaques could allow heater carbon monoxide emissions to leak into the area in which the heater is being used. Units: About 10,200. All recalled heaters have been returned to CFM..

title: CPSC, Family Dollar Stores Announce Recall of Spinning Star Christmas Tree Topper
summary: The tree topper can melt or smoke near the on/off switch, which could pose a fire hazard. Units: About 13,000.

title: CPSC, Meco Corp. Announce Recall to Repair Gas Grills
summary: The regulators on these gas grills, the component that controls the amount of gas released to the burner, can leak propane when the propane cylinder is connected and open, and the grill is not in use. Units: About 98,000.

title: CPSC, Black Diamond Equipment Announce Recall of Scarpa T2X Telemark Ski Boots
summary: The plastic boot cuff can crack when flexed open in an unbuckled non-skiing position, causing discomfort on the ankle or shin, making the problem evident prior to skiing and thus unsuitable for use. Units: About 2,300 pairs.

title: CPSC, Dell Announce Recall of Notebook Computer Batteries
summary: These batteries can overheat, which could pose a fire risk. Units: About 22,000 in the U.S..

title: CPSC, Advantage Publishers Group Announce Recall of Children's Books
summary: If the clear plastic container is removed from the book's back cover or breaks, young children can access the beads in it. This poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 41,000.

title: CPSC, General Electric Announce Recall of Gas Ranges Posing Fire Hazard
summary: These ranges were manufactured with a design flaw that can cause an electrical arc between the wiring and adjacent gas supply tubes at two locations in the control housing of the range, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,600.

title: CPSC, American Honda Motor Corp. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: A safety defect could exist in the transmission, that could allow the rider to downshift from 1st gear into reverse, without operating the reverse assist (lockout) lever. title: CPSC, Celebrate Express Inc. Announce Recall of Magic Party Favors and Costume Shield
summary: The magic party favors and the dragon ornament on the shield could break or crack, exposing sharp points that present a possible laceration hazard to children. Units: About 21,100 magic party favors and 25,500 costume shields.

title: CPSC, Maxim Enterprise Inc. Announce Recall of Mini Learning Cube Toy Sold at Target
summary: Small wooden pegs in the top corners of the toy can come loose, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 12,000.

title: CPSC, Kids II Inc. Announce Recall of Doorway Baby Jumpers
summary: The plastic clamp that attaches the jumper seat to a door frame can break, which can cause the unit and child to fall to the floor. This poses an injury hazard to young children. Units: About 14,000.
